description: This file implements the core methods of the torch::nn::Module class, including parameter management, submodule handling, serialization, and training mode toggling.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a neural network module with parameter and buffer management, submodule hierarchy, serialization, and training mode control.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the module, using RTTI if not explicitly set.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Placeholder for cloning the module; not implemented in base class.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a function to this module and its submodules, with various overloads for const and non-const.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Returns a vector of all parameters, optionally including submodules.

methods.name: named_parameters
methods.description: Returns an ordered dictionary of parameter names and tensors, optionally including submodules.

methods.name: buffers
methods.description: Returns a vector of all buffers, optionally including submodules.

methods.name: named_buffers
methods.description: Returns an ordered dictionary of buffer names and tensors, optionally including submodules.

methods.name: modules
methods.description: Returns a vector of all submodules, including or excluding self.

methods.name: named_modules
methods.description: Returns an ordered dictionary of module names and submodules.

methods.name: children
methods.description: Returns a vector of direct child modules.

methods.name: named_children
methods.description: Returns an ordered dictionary of child module names and modules.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Sets the module and its submodules to training mode.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Sets the module and its submodules to evaluation mode.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Moves the module to a specified device and/or dtype.

methods.name: is_training
methods.description: Returns whether the module is in training mode.

methods.name: zero_grad
methods.description: Zeros out gradients of parameters and buffers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes the module's parameters, buffers, and submodules.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the module's parameters, buffers, and submodules from an archive.

methods.name: is_serializable
methods.description: Indicates if the module can be serialized; always true in base class.

methods.name: register_parameter
methods.description: Registers a parameter tensor with the module.

methods.name: register_buffer
methods.description: Registers a buffer tensor with the module.

methods.name: unregister_module
methods.description: Removes a submodule by name.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Prints a brief description of the module.

methods.name: pretty_print_recursive
methods.description: Recursively prints the module and its submodules with indentation.

methods.name: clone_
methods.description: Placeholder for cloning logic; does nothing in base class.

methods.name: apply_to_submodules
methods.description: Helper to apply a function to all submodules recursively.

methods.name: shared_from_this_checked
methods.description: Returns a shared_ptr to this module, with error checking.
